articles.title: Hotel Owner and Son Assaulted Over False Beef Allegation in Bihar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A hotel owner and his son were allegedly assaulted by a group of youths in Bihar’s Purnea after being falsely accused of serving cow and buffalo meat.

body.html:
A hotel owner and his son were allegedly assaulted by a group of youths in Bihar’s Purnea after being falsely accused of serving cow and buffalo meat.

The incident took place on June 14 in the Gokulpur area under K Nagar Police Station, but videos of the assault surfaced on social media days later, triggering widespread outrage.

According to the complaint, the attackers were allegedly led by local resident Abhijeet Kumar Yadav. Viral videos showed hotel owner Mohammad Tajammul and his son being beaten with bamboo sticks, chairs and other objects.

In one video, the attackers are heard accusing the family of selling beef and demanding answers about the contents of the hotel refrigerator, asking, “Kya tha fridge me sach sach bolo?” The father and son were also allegedly forced to hold their ears, perform sit-ups and publicly apologise. Another video showed Tajammul touching the attackers’ feet and pleading with them to stop. A younger child present at the spot was also allegedly mishandled.

Dispute Began Over Unpaid Bill, Says Victim

Tajammul claimed the assault had nothing to do with beef. According to him, five men visited his hotel, ate mutton and rice, and refused to pay the bill.

“When I asked for payment, they started recording videos and falsely accused us of selling beef,” he alleged, adding that the family was so frightened after the attack that they were forced to leave the hotel premises.

Police Find No Beef During Investigation

After the videos went viral, police formed a special team to investigate the incident. A search of the hotel found no beef or any objectionable material.

In an official statement issued on June 17, police said the claims circulating on social media about cow and buffalo meat were misleading and baseless. Authorities confirmed that the assault occurred around 2 pm on June 14 and that the viral posts contained false and inflammatory allegations.

FIR Registered, Raids Underway

Based on the investigation, police registered an FIR against three named accused and several unidentified individuals, including the operator of the Facebook account that circulated the misleading video.

The accused have been booked for assault, criminal intimidation, spreading false information and hurting religious sentiments with the intent to disturb communal harmony. Police said raids are ongoing to arrest those involved.

Police Urge Public Not to Spread Rumours

Authorities have appealed to the public not to believe or share unverified information on social media, warning that strict action will be taken against anyone attempting to spread communal rumours or disturb social harmony through false claims.

articles.title: Dermatologist Held for Killing Domestic Help, Claims ‘Black Magic’ Behind Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dermatologist has been arrested for allegedly murdering his 45-year-old domestic help with a bat and a knife in South Delhi's upscale Mount Kailash area, police said on Thursday.

body.html:
A dermatologist has been arrested for allegedly murdering his 45-year-old domestic help with a bat and a knife in South Delhi's upscale Mount Kailash area, police said on Thursday.

During initial interrogation, the accused, Manish Gupta, claimed that the victim, Meena, had been practising black magic, which he alleged had disturbed the peace of his household and caused distress to his family members.

However, investigators said they have found no evidence to support the allegation. Police added that Gupta, who is believed to have been suffering from depression, has made multiple and varying claims during questioning, and the actual motive behind the murder remains unclear.

Meena had reportedly been working as a domestic help for Gupta for several years. Her body was found lying in a pool of blood on the terrace of the house.

According to police, a PCR call was received at 11.36 am, following which a team rushed to the spot and found Gupta sitting next to the victim's body. He was immediately taken into custody.

During interrogation, the accused allegedly confessed that he first attacked Meena with a bat and later stabbed her with a knife. Police recovered both weapons from the scene and seized them as evidence.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (Southeast) Hemant Tiwari said the motive behind the murder is still not clear and an investigation is underway to establish the circumstances of the crime.

A crime team inspected the scene, collected forensic evidence, scanned CCTV footage from nearby buildings and questioned local residents as part of the investigation.

The incident has shocked residents of the area and comes nearly two months after another high-profile crime in the locality involving the alleged rape and murder of an IRS officer's daughter by a former domestic help.

articles.title: RTO Chase Turns Into Highway Chaos! Dumper Driver Dumps Bricks on Expressway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dumper truck driver allegedly dumped a large quantity of bricks on the Eastern Peripheral Expressway in Uttar Pradesh while attempting to evade an RTO inspection, creating a major hazard for commuters and disrupting traffic movement.

body.html:
A dumper truck driver allegedly dumped a large quantity of bricks on the Eastern Peripheral Expressway in Uttar Pradesh while attempting to evade an RTO inspection, creating a major hazard for commuters and disrupting traffic movement.

According to reports, the driver was also seen driving on the wrong side of the highway before unloading the bricks onto the road, allegedly to block pursuing authorities and other vehicles.

Police and traffic personnel from Dadri rushed to the spot and launched a clearance operation. A JCB machine was deployed to remove the scattered bricks, while puncture repair assistance was arranged for motorists whose vehicles were damaged by the debris.

After a coordinated effort by the police and traffic management teams, traffic on the expressway was restored.

Authorities have initiated an investigation into the incident and are taking appropriate action against the driver.

articles.title: Sudden Brake on Mumbai–Pune Expressway Triggers Three-Car Pile-Up on Missing Link Bridge
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A three-car chain-reaction collision took place on the cable-stayed bridge of the Pune-bound Missing Link section of the Mumbai–Pune Expressway near Borghat, causing extensive damage to the vehicles but leaving all occupants unharmed.

body.html:
A three-car chain-reaction collision took place on the cable-stayed bridge of the Pune-bound Missing Link section of the Mumbai–Pune Expressway near Borghat, causing extensive damage to the vehicles but leaving all occupants unharmed.

According to preliminary information, the accident occurred when a Toyota Fortuner travelling from Mumbai towards Pune suddenly applied brakes and came to a halt in the third lane.

A Hyundai Verna following the SUV crashed into its rear, while a third car travelling behind the Verna also failed to stop in time and rammed into it, resulting in a three-vehicle pile-up.

Despite the significant damage to all three vehicles, no injuries or fatalities were reported, with all passengers escaping safely.

The incident briefly disrupted traffic on the expressway before normal movement was restored.

Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the circumstances that led to the accident.

articles.title: Elder Brother Allegedly Burns Younger Sibling’s Luxury Car in Tirunelveli

articles.excerpt: Tirunelveli: An alleged property dispute between two brothers took a dramatic turn after the elder sibling reportedly set fire to his younger brother’s luxury car near the Ganganangulam auto stand in Seranmahadevi, Tirunelveli district.

body.html:
Tirunelveli: An alleged property dispute between two brothers took a dramatic turn after the elder sibling reportedly set fire to his younger brother’s luxury car near the Ganganangulam auto stand in Seranmahadevi, Tirunelveli district.

According to preliminary information, the brothers had been locked in a long-standing dispute over family property and land. The conflict allegedly escalated on Thursday, culminating in the elder brother setting the vehicle on fire.

The blazing car drew the attention of local residents, causing a brief commotion in the area. However, no injuries or casualties were reported.

Police rushed to the spot and launched an investigation. Officials are collecting evidence and recording statements to establish the sequence of events and initiate appropriate legal action.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Flight Cancelled, Chaos Erupts! SpiceJet Staff Suspended After Abusing Passengers at Bagdogra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A SpiceJet staff member has been suspended after allegedly engaging in a heated verbal altercation and shouting abuses at passengers following the cancellation of a Delhi-bound flight at Bagdogra Airport in West Bengal.

body.html:
A SpiceJet staff member has been suspended after allegedly engaging in a heated verbal altercation and shouting abuses at passengers following the cancellation of a Delhi-bound flight at Bagdogra Airport in West Bengal.

The incident, which took place on June 13, gained widespread attention after a video of the confrontation went viral on social media. The footage shows a tense exchange between airline staff and passengers while security personnel attempted to calm the situation.

According to passengers, repeated delays throughout the day and the eventual cancellation of flight SG 151 sparked frustration and unrest at the airport.

In a statement, SpiceJet said the flight was cancelled due to a series of operational challenges, including adverse weather conditions that initially forced the aircraft to divert to Kolkata.

"Due to this unpredictable cancellation, some of the irate passengers and our staff members got involved in a verbal altercation. SpiceJet has taken necessary disciplinary action against the staff member. She has been served with immediate suspension of services and sent to refresher training," the airline said.

Passenger Noman Shaikh said the flight was originally scheduled to depart at 4:10 pm but faced repeated delays before passengers were informed that it would leave at 10 pm. However, later in the evening, they were told that the flight had been cancelled.

Shaikh also alleged that passengers were served undercooked rice and that no accommodation arrangements were made after the cancellation.

The situation escalated when stranded passengers confronted airline staff over the disruption, leading to a public exchange of abuses at Bagdogra Airport.

articles.title: Rs 21 Lakh to ‘Alleged Wife’? Martyr Air Force Officer’s Family Questions Compensation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The family of Flight Lieutenant Shubham Kumar, who lost his life in an Indian Air Force aircraft crash in Assam, has raised questions over a Rs 21 lakh compensation cheque allegedly handed over to a woman they describe as his "alleged wife." His father, Amarendra Sharma, said the family...

body.html:
The family of Flight Lieutenant Shubham Kumar, who lost his life in an Indian Air Force aircraft crash in Assam, has raised questions over a Rs 21 lakh compensation cheque allegedly handed over to a woman they describe as his "alleged wife."

His father, Amarendra Sharma, said the family knew about Shubham's relationship with Shreya Rai and had agreed to their marriage, but were unaware of any legal or court marriage. He claimed they were informed about the compensation only after the funeral.

While stating that a legally wedded wife has every right to the benefits, the family has sought clarity on the process and appealed to authorities for transparency and support.

The dispute has sparked debate over legal rights, communication and the distribution of compensation meant for the families of fallen servicemen.

articles.title: Speeding Car Turns Basement Into Horror Scene: Software Engineer Crushed in Noida Society
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking accident inside a residential society in Noida left a software engineer critically injured after a speeding car allegedly ran over her and her five-year-old daughter in the basement parking area.

body.html:
A shocking accident inside a residential society in Noida left a software engineer critically injured after a speeding car allegedly ran over her and her five-year-old daughter in the basement parking area. The incident occurred at Mahagun Mirabella Society in Sector 79, raising serious concerns over reckless driving inside residential complexes.

The injured woman, identified as Kritika Sharma, was rushed to hospital with severe injuries, while her daughter, Ayra, sustained minor injuries and was discharged after receiving first aid.

According to police and residents, the accident took place when Kritika and her family were unloading luggage from their parked vehicle and carrying belongings to their apartment. At that moment, a Honda Amaze allegedly entered the basement parking area at high speed and struck Kritika and her daughter.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced online and reportedly shows the car moving much faster than the permitted speed inside the parking zone. The impact knocked both victims to the ground and trapped them beneath the vehicle.

Hearing screams, residents rushed to the spot and immediately began rescue efforts.

Eyewitnesses said Kritika remained trapped under the vehicle for several minutes. While her husband, Arun Sharma, managed to pull their daughter to safety, residents lifted the car to free Kritika.

The family was taken to Fortis Hospital, where doctors treated Kritika for multiple serious injuries. Her daughter was discharged after medical evaluation.

According to Arun Sharma, his wife suffered multiple rib fractures, a broken collarbone, head injuries and abdominal trauma. She also reportedly sustained burn injuries caused by the heat of the vehicle while trapped underneath.

Doctors performed surgery on her ribs and shoulder, and she continues to recover under medical supervision.

Police from Sector 113 police station reached the society after receiving information about the accident and launched an investigation. The driver, identified as businessman Anil, was taken into custody.

Some residents alleged that the driver appeared to be intoxicated at the time of the crash. However, police said a medical examination did not confirm alcohol consumption.

A case has been registered, and investigators are examining CCTV footage and witness statements.

Residents have also raised concerns about safety inside the basement parking area, stating that the accident spot has two sharp turns and a speed limit of 10 kmph. They alleged that the car was travelling at nearly four times the permitted speed.

Several residents questioned whether additional safety measures, including convex mirrors and stricter speed-control mechanisms, could have prevented the accident.

#Noida #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #CCTV #MahagunMirabella

articles.title: Nalgonda Police Arrest Accused in NTR Idol Arson Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nalgonda Police have arrested the accused in connection with the burning of an NTR idol on June 6. According to police, the suspects allegedly covered the statue with bedsheets, poured petrol, and set it on fire.

body.html:
Nalgonda Police have arrested the accused in connection with the burning of an NTR idol on June 6. According to police, the suspects allegedly covered the statue with bedsheets, poured petrol, and set it on fire.

Based on CCTV footage, investigators identified the accused as arriving in a Baleno car (TS 07 HT 2430) after appearing to offer prayers at the idol. Graduate MLC Independent candidate Palkoori Ashok Kumar Goud and Eranti Praneet have been arrested, and a case has been registered under the PD Act.
